meta.title: Fix VM main execution and update Rosetta outputs
meta.body_summary: Add deterministic time seed to rosetta VM tests, optimize Append instruction by preallocating slice capacity, and update 100-prisoners benchmark IR outputs.

perf_labels.notes: Small VM optimization and rosetta test stabilization by OpenAI_Codex; closed as stale with merge conflicts after long inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 90 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a tiny performance and determinism fix that was closed due to staleness rather than review rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: PR remained open for ~8 months without review or merge activity; author closed it due to difficulty resolving conflicts cleanly and content being superseded by main.
review_details.performance_claim: Preallocating slice capacity in Append instruction improves performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author closed with comment 'too old to resolve conflicts cleanly; content superseded by main.' No external review rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: This small-scope VM optimization and test update PR was left open for ~8 months without review, eventually closed by the author due to merge conflicts. The agent's boundary here is mainly in the development workflow: lack of maintainer engagement and eventual staleness prevented merging, rather than a technical or evidence deficiency.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body mentions testing with rosetta golden test (MOCHI_ROSETTA_INDEX=4 ...) but no benchmark or profiler data to verify speed-up.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, the Append instruction is optimized by preallocating slice capacity based on the new length before copying elements. In rosetta_test.go, the VM is seeded with a deterministic time source (time.Now replaced by seeded value) to make golden file tests reproducible. Rosetta IR outputs for 100-prisoners benchmark are refreshed accordingly.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Benchmark and rosetta output files are minor updates reflecting IR changes; ROSETTA.md entry is a checklist/metadata update.
change_trajectory: Single commit (f22cca56) includes all changes: preallocate slice in Append, seed VM with fixed time in test, update rosetta IR outputs and benchmark entry.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created by tamnd with a single commit containing VM optimization and test updates.
